column49:
The Homes Supply team is responsible for growing Airbnb’s supply base and ensuring we maintain a diverse, high-quality portfolio of home listings that meet guest expectations for value, variety, and experience. The team also supports hosts globally by enabling efficient planning and execution of growth strategies that align with Airbnb’s mission and resonate with local communities.

The Difference You Will Make:

In this role, you’ll shape the growth and performance of Airbnb’s Homes business across Canada. Leading a team of Market Managers, you’ll drive strategies that expand high-quality supply, strengthen host success across every segment, and enhance the guest experience. You’ll work hand-in-hand with the Country Manager to execute country strategic plans, translating vision into measurable results. Through close collaboration with cross-functional partners, you’ll ensure Airbnb continues to deliver exceptional value to both guests and hosts in every market.

A Typical Day:

  • Lead and inspire a team of Market Managers and Market Associates to grow Airbnb’s Homes supply across Canada, expanding partnerships with hosts of all types and driving exceptional business and guest outcomes.
  • Partner closely with the Country Manager to execute country strategic plans, ensuring alignment between local market execution and national business priorities.
  • Design and execute acquisition strategies to bring new, high-quality supply to Airbnb by developing innovative programs, pilots, and local initiatives to reach untapped segments and markets.
  • Experiment boldly to unlock new sources of supply - measure results, refine quickly, and turn proven strategies into playbooks that fuel Airbnb’s growth across Canada and beyond.
  • Guide territory-level strategies for acquisition, optimization, and host quality, directing teams to tailor their approach based on market maturity and host segmentation.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Supply Leadership, Marketing, RevOps, Policy, and Product to launch initiatives that improve host performance and accelerate supply growth.
  • Monitor and own business performance, ensuring markets meet revenue, supply, and quality KPIs while delivering sustainable results that support Airbnb’s broader goals.
  • Identify market trends and opportunities, providing solutions to overcome barriers and capitalize on emerging demand or regulatory shifts.
  • Coach and develop talent, building a high-performing team culture that values experimentation, accountability, and continuous growth.

Your Expertise:

  • 12+ years of experience in global operations, business development, or marketplace management, with 5+ years in a people-leadership role managing and scaling teams.
  • Deep market expertise and strong understanding of the Canadian travel and hospitality landscape, with experience driving local growth and community engagement.
  • A combination of operational and commercial skills that will allow you to acquire supply across multiple channels.
  • A bold, compassionate, and action-oriented leader with a strong bias for action and a proven ability to develop, coach, and empower high-performing teams.
  • Analytical and strategic thinker who uses data and insights to uncover opportunities, shape portfolio strategies, and guide decisions across diverse and evolving markets.
  • Proven ability to influence product, policy, and cross-functional teams to unlock new revenue streams and improve host and market performance.
  • Skilled at leveraging tools, dashboards, and analytics to assess performance, identify trends, and drive accountability.
  • Demonstrated success in achieving strong results through others, including effective performance management and development of emerging leaders.
  • Known for creating a positive, driven, and inclusive team culture grounded in collaboration, transparency, and continuous improvement.
  • Recognized as a go-to leader who provides clear direction, constructive feedback, and hands-on business coaching to drive both results and professional growth.
  • Highly organized and adept at leading multiple initiatives simultaneously, turning strategy into action and results.
  • Previous experience growing supply and building partnerships with community and host groups is highly valued.

column3: Airbnb’s Public Policy team partners with governments, legislators, regulators, and community stakeholders to shape fair, forward-looking rules for the sharing economy. We work across local, national, and regional levels to ensure policymakers understand the economic and social value our host community brings to cities and countries, while addressing legitimate concerns around housing, safety, and community impact. Combining rigorous policy analysis with strategic partnerships, research, data insights, community engagement, media strategy, and targeted advocacy campaigns, we operate both proactively and reactively to advance sustainable regulatory frameworks. Our goal is to create durable policy solutions that enable our hosts to thrive, support responsible tourism, and position Airbnb as a constructive, long-term partner to governments and communities.&lt
&lt

The Head of Policy, ANZ (Policy Lead) is responsible for developing and executing a fully integrated plan across Australia and New Zealand, using all available strategies and resources, informed by data, local insights and best practices that aims to protect and further the growth of Airbnb and our community.&lt

The Head of Policy, ANZ (Policy Lead) is also responsible for working in partnership with the supporting the relevant cross functional teams in identifying strategic business opportunities in the region, ensuring that opportunities to implement projects and initiatives in the region are flagged&lt
&lt

Strategy development and execution: Own the development and execution of comprehensive public policy strategies for each priority state in Australia and/or New Zealand, as determined through close collaboration with the Regional Director for Asia Pacific, the Country Manager for Australia and New Zealand and other cross-functional leaders in Australia and New Zealand. This includes securing regulatory clarity, mitigating business risk, and enabling sustainable supply growth. It will entail the development of detailed plans for achieving policy outcomes using earned and paid media, digital communication, mobilization tactics and partnership development.&amp

Government and regulatory engagement: Develop and maintain trusted relationships with senior policymakers, regulators, legislators, and enforcement authorities at local, state, and national levels. Lead legislative and regulatory engagement, including negotiating statutory language, drafting regulatory submissions, shaping implementation guidance, and advancing policy reforms that support responsible home sharing and tourism growth.&lt

Campaign design and execution: Design and execute integrated advocacy campaigns that combine policy analysis, research, media strategy, coalition building, community mobilization, digital engagement, and strategic partnerships. Deploy a range of tools — from data-driven research and economic analysis to earned and paid media — to influence policy outcomes and shift public narratives.&lt

Business advisory and cross-functional leadership: Advise senior leadership and cross-functional teams (Legal, Communications, Supply, Marketing) on regulatory developments and emerging risks. Translate complex policy environments into clear strategic recommendations that inform operational decisions, and go-to-market strategies.&lt

Team leadership: Lead and develop a high-performing public policy team, setting clear priorities, performance expectations, and accountability frameworks. Foster an inclusive culture grounded in collaboration, integrity, and strategic rigor. Ensure disciplined execution, resource allocation, and stakeholder alignment.&lt

Coalition and stakeholder development: Build and manage coalitions with industry partners, trade associations, civil society groups, research institutions, and community stakeholders. Identify and cultivate credible third-party advocates to support policy objectives.&lt

External advocacy and reputation management: Represent Airbnb at senior political and industry forums, and serve as a spokesperson when appropriate. Proactively manage reputational risks and respond to emerging regulatory challenges with coordinated, strategic engagement.&lt

Risk mitigation: Continuously monitor legislative and regulatory developments, anticipate emerging threats, and implement mitigation strategies to protect the company’s operating model and long-term growth trajectory.&lt

Consultant and resource management: Manage the ANZ Policy budget, and external advisors and consultants, ensuring alignment with strategic priorities, clear deliverables, and disciplined execution.&lt
&amp
&lt
Experience and Policy Expertise&lt
At least twelve (12) years of experience working on complex public policy, regulatory, or legislative issues in government, private sector, consulting, or non-governmental organizations
column4: experience spanning both public and private sectors is preferred.&lt

column3: Demonstrated track record of influencing regulatory or legislative outcomes, including shaping statutory language, regulatory frameworks, or implementation guidance.&lt
Direct experience in one or more relevant sectors such as tourism, housing, land use, urban policy, technology platforms, digital marketplaces, or e-commerce regulation.&lt
Experience operating in politically sensitive or high-profile regulatory environments where media, community, and stakeholder dynamics materially influence outcomes.&lt
Leadership and Organizational Capability&lt
Significant people leadership experience, including building, developing, and retaining high-performing teams.&lt
Demonstrated strength in delegation, performance management, coaching, and succession planning.&lt
Experience leading through ambiguity and change, setting clear priorities in fast-moving environments with competing demands.&lt
Proven ability to manage external advisors and consultants with disciplined accountability and strategic alignment.&lt

column12: Airbnb’s Public Policy team partners with governments, legislators, regulators, and community stakeholders to shape fair, forward-looking rules for the sharing economy. column3: The mission of the Airbnb Global Safety and Risk Management (GSRM) team, as a component of Fraud and Safety Operations, is to foster a safe, secure, and healthy workplace for our employee community and peace of mind for Airbnb’s global community. Airbnb GSRM programs include Global Threat Assessment Program

The Global Law Enforcement Liaison team is comprised of Law Enforcement Operations (LE Ops) and Global Law Enforcement Engagement (GLEE). LE Ops is responsible for liaising with law enforcement agencies on public safety and/or criminal matters with an alleged nexus to Airbnb. This includes processing law enforcement data disclosure requests, contributing to law enforcement investigations involving Airbnb stakeholders, and advancing trusted relationships with international law enforcement agencies in the interest of public and life safety. Working alongside LE Ops, the GLEE practice conducts strategic bilateral and multilateral engagement with international law enforcement entities and relevant domestic security services in a proactive manner to develop and nurture new relationships and strengthen established trusted relationships with partners to mitigate online and offline criminal and life safety threats to the Airbnb community.&amp

The Global Law Enforcement Engagement Regional Lead for Europe, the Middle East, and Africa (EMEA) is responsible for driving strategic bilateral and multilateral communication, cooperation, and collaboration efforts with law enforcement entities and domestic security services located and/or operating in EMEA to protect Airbnb equities and stakeholders from criminal threats and acts of violence in close coordination with other Airbnb GSRM teams. The Global Law Enforcement Engagement Regional Lead for EMEA&amp
column5: will report directly to the Manager, Global Law Enforcement Engagement.&amp

column3: Airbnb is seeking a Legal Intern to join the France Legal team for a 6-month internship.&lt

The Legal team at Airbnb embodies the company’s innovative and entrepreneurial spirit. Airbnb continues to break new ground in matters of policy and law around the world. Where some see obstacles, we see opportunities to find creative and practical solutions. We’re an adventurous, fast-moving group that supports many functions and teams across the company.&lt

The France Legal Team oversees a broad spectrum of matters, ranging from litigation to public affairs, commercial work, and regulatory compliance, amongst others. The team collaborates extensively across various departments, supporting cross-functional initiatives and ensuring alignment with both organizational objectives and legal requirements.&lt
&amp
&lt

As an intern, you’ll be integrated into a small and dynamic team where you’ll contribute to challenging projects. Your manager, team, and our employee community will strive to be superhosts to you. We provide the support, mentorship, fun, and real world experience needed to accelerate your learning and make a real impact on our product, as Airbnb revolutionizes connection, belonging, and travel.&lt
&amp
&lt

Collaborate with team members to achieve project milestones&lt

Proactively seek and provide feedback throughout the internship&lt

Airbnb is seeking a Legal Intern to join the France Legal team for a 6-month internship.

The Legal team at Airbnb embodies the company’s innovative and entrepreneurial spirit. Airbnb continues to break new ground in matters of policy and law around the world. Where some see obstacles, we see opportunities to find creative and practical solutions. We’re an adventurous, fast-moving group that supports many functions and teams across the company.

The France Legal Team oversees a broad spectrum of matters, ranging from litigation to public affairs, commercial work, and regulatory compliance, amongst others. The team collaborates extensively across various departments, supporting cross-functional initiatives and ensuring alignment with both organizational objectives and legal requirements.
column46:
The difference you will make:

As an intern, you’ll be integrated into a small and dynamic team where you’ll contribute to challenging projects. Your manager, team, and our employee community will strive to be superhosts to you. We provide the support, mentorship, fun, and real world experience needed to accelerate your learning and make a real impact on our product, as Airbnb revolutionizes connection, belonging, and travel.
column47:
A typical day:

You will work with members of the legal team, including other interns, and folks from across the organization to support a variety of legal functions, which may include: Regulatory/Policy, Litigation, Commercial, Marketing, Product, Corporate, Privacy, Employment, etc. You’ll get exposure to many functional areas, and will have opportunities to work on legal questions for multiple of these teams.

As an intern, you’ll be expected to:

  • Collaborate with team members to achieve project milestones
  • Complete projects crossing different areas of law, balancing priorities and deadlines
  • Communicate with the legal team and other stakeholders to provide project updates and share your work
  • Proactively seek and provide feedback throughout the internship
  • Actively participate in and contribute to the legal and broader Airbnb community

La différence que vous ferez :

Airbnb s'attend à la plus grosse reprise des voyages du siècle avec la fin de la pandémie de COVID-19 dans le monde et la réouverture complète des voyages internationaux. Airbnb se réinvente en raison de son introduction en bourse et du monde post-pandémique. La stratégie marketing et produit d'Airbnb a évolué et devient de plus en plus sophistiquée et exigeante. En conséquence, l'équipe de localisation a grandi rapidement avec l'entreprise et a constamment évolué et augmenté notre portée, notre impact et notre influence.

Notre équipe collabore avec les équipes de lancement pour tous les contenus, en lançant des fonctionnalités de produits de base complexes comme le Translation Engine, un service de traduction automatique spécialisé adapté au contenu généré par les utilisateurs.

En tant que responsable de la localisation, vous jouerez un rôle central dans nos efforts d'expansion internationale, une priorité absolue pour Airbnb. Vous rejoindrez l'équipe de direction principale de votre région, façonnant les initiatives locales et adaptant les stratégies mondiales pour répondre aux besoins du marché. Votre rôle consistera non seulement à piloter la stratégie linguistique, mais aussi à favoriser la collaboration avec les parties prenantes internes et les partenaires externes pour créer des produits internationalisés qui sont bien adaptés aux publics locaux.

Les responsables de la localisation agissent en tant qu'experts linguistiques et culturels en collaborant avec les équipes locales pour élaborer une stratégie visant à stimuler la croissance de l'entreprise, en adaptant et en développant des produits et des services qui répondent aux besoins locaux. Vous devez porter le ton, le style et la voix d'Airbnb, ainsi que garantir la qualité et l'excellence dans votre langue. En tant que responsable de la localisation, vous êtes non seulement passionné·e par les langues et les cultures, mais aussi par l'idée d'offrir à nos utilisateurs une expérience native sur toutes les plateformes.

Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.&lt

column3: The Airbnb Hotels team is a fun, fast-growing group leading Airbnb’s expansion into the hotel sector. Operating with an entrepreneurial spirit, this team combines the simplicity, product excellence, and guest-centered ethos that define Airbnb. This team’s mission is to deliver the smoothest, most intuitive hotel booking experience for guests, while helping hotels easily drive incremental bookings so they can focus on delivering the best hospitality. The ultimate aim is to help more people discover high-quality hotels, creating value for guests and our hotel partners.&lt
&lt

As a Manager, Connectivity Partner, you will be responsible for managing and executing strategy to the overall Hotels Connectivity. You will develop and lead a high-performing team responsible for the relationship management, enablement, and performance management of Airbnb’s Connectivity partners (i.e Channel managers, CRS and PMS systems). These connectivities enable real-time inventory updates, automated reservation delivery, and improved visibility, allowing hotels to drive bookings. This role will be accountable for helping grow Airbnb’s business through software partners. You will be responsible for setting up team and strategies, exceeding quarterly business and technical KPIs, establishing world-class account management practices, and mentoring and motivating your team members. You will be reporting to the Senior Manager, Global Enterprise and Connectivity Partners.&lt
&lt
Manage distributed team of Connectivity Partner Managers and Specialists and assist in partner management and new business development for supply acquisition&lt
Responsible for the team to meet and exceed quarterly revenue, supply acquisition goals and other OKRs&lt
Develop and execute a global strategy playbook, working closely with a distributed team of Connectivity Partners. Work closely with the Homes Connectivity team business as well.&amp

Create operational rhythm, establish and track KPIs, analyze business growth and other key metrics to identify trends, drive new business opportunities, and ensure resolution of business challenges with a sense of urgency&lt
Establish and maintain successful business practices for managing strategic connectivity partners&lt
Drive success with strategic partners&lt
Monitor business needs and work closely with Product, Technical Support, and Account Management and Sales Leadership to help drive feature adoption and business performance&lt
Serve as primary Airbnb point of contact for all internal questions, escalations and service improvements regarding connectivity partners&lt
&lt
10+ years of professional experience working in sales/account management roles - tourism, e-commerce, and hospitality is required&lt
3-5 years experience managing and leading highly effective teams with proven track record of meeting and exceeding goals&lt
Proven to contribute and drive solutions to hotels supply acquisition and revenue goals&lt
Highly motivated and engaged team builder with ability to coach and mentor Connectivity team members&lt
Experience developing and driving channel sales and marketing initiatives in collaboration with Connectivity team members&lt
Ability to develop a strategy, communicate it clearly and get buy-in and support to execute against quarterly goals&lt
Strong analytical skills to identify opportunities, operationalize execution, and drive business results&lt
Ability to influence senior Airbnb leadership level or within partners leadership teams&lt
Ability to work within a matrix, solve problems and influence cross-functional teams

The Supply organization plays a pivotal role in driving Airbnb’s growth and expansion efforts worldwide. This team recruits and develops Airbnb’s global supply of high-quality Services. By focusing on quality supply and international expansion, the team leads the way for Airbnb’s continued growth and the facilitation of millions more host and guest connections.&lt
&lt

As a Market Associate, you will support the growth of differentiated service products by helping identify, onboard, and manage high-quality service providers in your assigned territory. You’ll contribute to creating positive Guest and Host experiences by executing core supply acquisition and revenue driving activities, including supporting onboarding, analyzing market data and optimizing hosts/store front.&lt

In this role, you’ll collaborate closely with senior market leaders and cross-functional partners while developing strong local market knowledge. You’ll support localized supply initiatives across both established and emerging markets, contribute insights from the field, and grow your skills in marketplace operations, relationship management, and execution as you build toward greater ownership over time.&lt
&lt
Develop strategies to optimize your book of business and drive revenue growth.&lt
Execute daily initiatives to optimize a large host portfolio and deliver measurable impact.&lt
Leverage data insights to identify and act on strategic opportunities for revenue growth, supporting your decisions with data.&lt
Own and nurture your book of business within your territory, ensuring host engagement and representing Airbnb in external meetings.&lt
Continuously deepen your knowledge of assigned markets and service categories to inform your strategy and execution.&lt
Maintain an understanding of software partner integrations, educate clients on product changes, and relay feedback to internal teams.&lt
Collaborate cross-functionally with internal teams to enable growth and influence business development.&lt
&lt

Effective time management and prioritization in ambiguous environments.&lt
Excellent communication skills with clients and partners.&lt
Ability to build and maintain relationships with external partners.&lt

column4: s approach to accommodation and travel. We are creating highly local, personal and authentic experiences for our host and guest community around the world. Our platform connects millions of people a year and furthers our mission to create a world where anyone can belong anywhere.&lt

column3: To power the global Airbnb community, we are building a world-class payments platform - one that currently supports 191 countries, 63 currencies, connects dozens of payment providers and banks, and processes billions of dollars per year for all of Airbnb’s business units. As the platform grows, we’ll be adding new payment partners, establishing licensed payments companies around the world, and building innovative payment experiences and financial products for our guests and hosts. column9: We are seeking a Manager to lead every aspect of payments partnerships and related tasks across the partner life cycle including payments subject matter expertise, partner relationship management, business development, incident management, network compliance, and cross-functional collaboration for Pay-ins and Networks.&lt

column3: Rejoignez lʼéquipe dynamique et innovante de recrutement Foundation d’Airbnb, où la constitution dʼéquipes diversifiées est notre priorité absolue. Dans un environnement d’affaires en constante évolution, cette équipe dispose d’une occasion unique de bâtir des relations consultatives avec les partenaires – et d’agir à titre de conseillère ou conseiller – afin de recruter les meilleurs talents de leur génération !&lt
La différence que vous ferez:&lt

Votre principale responsabilité sera de mener à bien les recherches de talents et d’offrir une expérience exceptionnelle aux candidates, candidats et gestionnaires recruteurs. Notre équipe adopte une approche consultative : nous travaillons en étroite collaboration avec les parties prenantes pour comprendre leurs besoins et proposer des solutions sur mesure. Dévoué·e·s à la recherche et à l’embauche des meilleurs talents du marché, nous veillons à ce que chaque personne en interaction avec le processus de recrutement d’Airbnb se sente valorisée et soutenue.&lt
Une journée typique:&lt

Gérer et mener un processus complet de recrutement : repérage, présélection, entrevues, rétroaction et offres d’emploi pour des candidates et candidats de tous niveaux, du débutant au niveau supérieur.&lt
Constituer des bassins de talents pour plusieurs postes dans diverses équipes et régions, en tenant compte de la diversité et de l’importance de proposer des listes de candidatures équilibrées.&lt
Favoriser l’inclusion en créant des viviers de talents diversifiés dès le haut de l’entonnoir.&lt
Collaborer avec les partenaires RH, les gestionnaires recruteurs, les opérations RH et les finances pour élaborer des stratégies et des plans d’embauche.&lt
Influencer les leaders d’affaires et former les gestionnaires recruteurs sur le processus, les meilleures pratiques d’entrevue et la prise de décisions.&lt
Offrir une expérience exceptionnelle aux candidates et candidats. Trouver de nouvelles façons de surprendre et ravir les personnes qui participent à notre processus d’entrevue.&lt
Assurer le suivi précis des données des candidates et candidats et utiliser correctement les systèmes afin de pouvoir rendre compte à l’entreprise.&lt
Détecter, intéresser et recruter les personnes les plus talentueuses, brillantes et passionnées pour Airbnb en utilisant des approches nouvelles et créatives.&lt
Représenter Airbnb avec intégrité et professionnalisme. Parler avec passion et authenticité d’Airbnb et de notre mission.&lt
Votre expertise:&lt
5 à 7 ans (ou plus) d’expérience en recrutement complet (full-cycle) requise.&lt
Expérience dans le recrutement à volume élevé pour des rôles généraux et administratifs requise.&lt
Expérience dans le soutien à une fonction d’opérations mondiales, y compris des rôles en soutien à la clientèle, un atout.&lt
Antécédents éprouvés pour repérer, évaluer et recruter des talents exceptionnels.&lt
Excellentes aptitudes en communication écrite et orale, avec capacité démontrée de transmettre des concepts complexes de manière concise et claire.&lt
Solides compétences en analyse et en influence.&lt
Attitude positive et proactive

column3: Notre engagement envers l’inclusion et le sentiment d’appartenance:&lt

Airbnb s’engage à recruter dans le bassin de talents le plus vaste possible. Chaque jour, les Hôtes proposent des séjours et des expériences uniques qui permettent aux invités de se connecter de manière plus authentique aux communautés.

La communauté qui vous attend
column15:
Chaque jour, les hôtes Airbnb proposent des séjours et des expériences uniques qui permettent aux voyageurs de tisser des liens avec les communautés de manière plus authentique. Depuis les débuts d'Airbnb, plus de 5 millions d'hôtes ont accueilli plus de 1,5 milliard de voyageurs dans presque tous les pays du monde.

L'organisation de la direction commerciale joue un rôle central dans les efforts de croissance et d'expansion de l'entreprise dans le monde entier. Nos collègues travaillent à la commercialisation des nouvelles entreprises et des entreprises existantes d'Airbnb pour permettre à Airbnb de devenir plus qu'une plateforme d'hébergement. Il s'agit notamment de faire du recrutement et de développer l'offre mondiale de séjours, d'expériences et de services de qualité d'Airbnb, ainsi que de mettre en œuvre la stratégie mondiale d'Airbnb dans le marché. En mettant l'accent sur la stratégie commerciale, l'approvisionnement de qualité et l'expansion internationale, l'équipe ouvre la voie à la croissance et au succès continus d'Airbnb dans son prochain chapitre.

L'équipe des opérations régionales, qui fait partie de la division des opérations commerciales au Canada, veille à ce que les activités d'Airbnb soient pertinentes au niveau local et répondent aux besoins des hôtes et des voyageurs du monde entier en aidant les régions à planifier et à mettre en œuvre plus efficacement des stratégies de croissance dans les domaines de l'offre, de la demande et d'autres secteurs d'une manière qui rejoint la communauté.

Pour accompagner le développement de nos activités, on veut faire appel aux meilleurs et aux plus brillants talents pour prendre de bonnes décisions commerciales stratégiques. À cette fin, l'équipe est à la recherche d'un ou une responsable des opérations commerciales pour se joindre à notre équipe des opérations commerciales au Canada.

Votre contribution
column16:
:

Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les leaders et les équipes interfonctionnelles et jouerez un rôle clé dans le développement de nos programmes axés sur la croissance et l'optimisation de la communauté. Le ou la candidate retenue relèvera du directeur ou de la directrice nationale au Canada.

Journée typique
column18:
• Aligner toutes les fonctions dans le but d'atteindre les objectifs fixés avec la direction du Canada.
  • Organiser des réunions régulières sur les opérations commerciales et amorcer des conversations constructives, en plus d'organiser des réunions hebdomadaires avec des équipes de projet interfonctionnelles (opérations sur le terrain et en ligne, marketing, produits, services juridiques) pour s'assurer que les initiatives clés sont sur la bonne voie au Canada.
  • Étudier les tendances macroéconomiques et microéconomiques et présenter des analyses, des rapports et des plans d'action à l'équipe de direction nationale et régionale d'Airbnb pour lui permettre de prendre des décisions commerciales stratégiques.
  • Soutenir le directeur ou la directrice nationale au Canada et d'autres hauts dirigeants dans le cadre de projets stratégiques clés, en plus de diriger et mettre en œuvre des projets opérationnels et stratégiques ad hoc pour le Canada. Peut devoir coordonner ses activités avec les équipes nationales, régionales et locales à San Francisco.
  • S'occuper de la conception, de l'exécution et de l'évaluation des initiatives interfonctionnelles de bout en bout. Concrètement, il s'agit de définir un énoncé de problème précis, d'articuler la solution idéale à ce problème, et d'identifier les principales dépendances qui entravent la solution, puis de travailler avec les parties prenantes interfonctionnelles pour la mettre en œuvre. Ces initiatives couvriront les domaines de la demande, de l'offre et de la réglementation de l'entreprise.

>Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

The Media Foundation team is at the forefront of building the platform that powers all of Airbnb's media experiences—from the photos that help guests find their perfect stay to the videos and animations that bring the Airbnb platform to life.
column53:
Joining the team, you will work closely with a skilled group of backend, infrastructure, and cross-platform engineers passionate about building scalable, reliable systems that serve billions of media assets to millions of users worldwide. You'll collaborate across Airbnb on projects ranging from media processing pipelines and intelligent metadata extraction to cost optimization and platform modernization.

The Difference You Will Make:

As a Senior Backend Software Engineer, your expertise will be pivotal in building and scaling the infrastructure that underpins Airbnb's media platform. You will design and implement backend systems that process, store, and serve media assets with high reliability and performance. Your work will directly enable product teams across Airbnb to build richer, more engaging experiences for hosts and guests.

You will have early ownership opportunities in areas such as:

  • Building capabilities to trigger ML/AI analysis on media assets, store extracted metadata, and serve results to downstream teams—enabling richer, smarter experiences for hosts and guests
  • Driving initiatives to reduce infrastructure costs through in-house image transformations, storage optimizations, and vendor consolidation
  • Amplifying the capabilities of our platform in serving images, videos, and additional media types, shaping the cutting-edge media capabilities at Airbnb

If you thrive at the intersection of infrastructure and product impact, and enjoy solving complex distributed systems challenges at scale, this role is for you.

A Typical Day:
column54:
• Design, develop, and maintain backend services and data pipelines that power media ingestion, processing, and serving at Airbnb scale
  • Build platform capabilities that enable ML/AI teams to trigger analysis workflows, store extracted metadata, and access media intelligence across product surfaces
  • Work closely with engineers from product teams across Airbnb, understanding their media needs and building self-serve solutions to address them
  • Continuously optimize and improve the performance, reliability, and cost-efficiency of existing media infrastructure
  • Stay current with industry trends in distributed systems, media processing, ML infrastructure, and workflow orchestration frameworks
  • Mentor and guide team members in their career development, fostering a culture of continuous learning and growth

Your Expertise:

  • 5+ years of experience in backend software engineering, with strong foundations in building and operating large-scale distributed systems, and demonstrated experience with media-related technologies (image processing, video transcoding, or metadata management)
  • Experience building data pipelines, batch processing systems, or platforms that support ML/AI workflows is highly valued
  • Proficiency in Java, Kotlin, or similar backend languages, with experience designing APIs and data models
  • Excellent collaboration and communication abilities, with a track record of partnering effectively with cross-functional teams including other ML/AI infra experts

Your Location:

This position is US - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. column9: Airbnb is a global hospitality platform that connects travelers with unique accommodations and experiences around the world. Our mission is to create a world where anyone can belong anywhere. Community Blueprint is a team under Global Operations that aims to improve the quality of the end-to-end customer journey and bridge team silos across product, operations, and policy. To do this, we need to be experts in the guest and Host experience and in how the product, operations, policies function together to deliver the Airbnb experience. As part of the Community Blueprint team, your role will be instrumental in driving data-driven decision-making, connecting data across product &amp
column11: operations, and enhancing the guest and Host experience.&lt

column3: &lt

We are seeking a highly experienced and skilled leader with deep expertise in customer journey analysis, strategic planning, and team development. As the Senior Manager, you are a leader that will be responsible for driving forward customer experience excellence, developing insights that identify user experience gaps, and growing the team’s impact on the business. The ability to connect the dots across the end-to-end customer journey and across different teams will be critical to success. This role will also be presenting to and influencing leaders at the highest level, meaning strong communication skills will be essential.&lt
This role will be part of the Frontline Insights &amp
column5: Execution (FIX) team within Community Blueprint. This is a highly cross functional team, this means you will collaborate with many different functions across all of Airbnb to drive strategic initiatives and inform decisions that will ultimately improve the guest and host experience. We are looking for a scrappy self-starter with an entrepreneurial mindset who thrives in ambiguity and can deeply understand the nuances of our rapidly evolving business and use data to make key decisions..&lt

column3: &lt
Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team, providing regular feedback, coaching, and performance evaluations.&lt
Foster a collaborative and supportive team environment that encourages growth, knowledge sharing, and innovation.&lt
Oversee workload management, resource allocation, and project prioritization for the team.&lt
Develop and implement key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure team effectiveness and impact.&lt
Collaborate with cross-functional leaders to align with broader company goals and objectives.&lt
Analyze quantitative and qualitative data across the end-to-end customer journey to drive business decisions.&lt
Identifying customer issues and understanding the what as well as investigating the why.&amp
Leverage LLMs/generative AI tools to enhance the effectiveness of the team.&lt

Develop strong working relationships and collaborative partnerships with the various internal teams such as Product, Operations, Engineering, Training, Knowledge Management, Incident Management, Business Process Improvement, Partner Management, Finance, Research, and others.&lt
This is a global program, which means this role will be working with people from many different time zones and requires flexibility in the hours they’re available to take meetings.&lt
Stay up-to-date with the latest industry trends and advancements in quantitative and qualitative data analysis techniques.&lt
&lt

An undergraduate degree with a strong preference for candidates holding an MBA or equivalent advanced degree, with 12+ years of industry experience in a General Manager, Strategy Manager, Product Insights, Product Operations or equivalent role.&lt
Proficiency in SQL, data analysis, and data visualization.&lt
Proficiency in Jira and Airtable (optional).&lt
Strong technical data skills, ability to connect data across multiple areas.&lt
Self-starter, thrives in ambiguity, and has an investigator mindset of wanting to get to the bottom of problems.&amp
Strong problem-solving and critical thinking abilities, with a keen attention to detail.&lt
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to effectively communicate complex concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.&lt
Exceptional stakeholder management skills, with a proven ability to collaborate and influence across functions.&lt
An agile, growth-minded approach, demonstrated through a history of driving projects from ideation to impact.&lt
Robust business acumen, strategic thinking skills, and the ability to make informed judgments.&lt
Experience managing a team including performance management and goal setting.&lt
Experience managing projects involving cross-functional teams.&lt
Understanding of LLMs and desire to continue to learn in the AI space.&lt
Flexible and can deal effectively with changes in priorities or ambiguity.&lt
Prior experience in the technology industry or a fast-paced, data-driven environment is preferred&lt

Joining the Airbnb team as a Senior Manager of the Community Blueprint Team will provide you with an exciting opportunity to contribute to the growth and success of a global technology company. If you are a highly analytical, detail-oriented, and strategic thinker with a passion for data-driven decision-making, we would love to hear from you&lt

Senior Software Engineer, AI Products (India)

Company Overview

Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join

The Airfam Products team exists to make every Airbnb employee more productive through a unified digital headquarters experience. As part of a 13-person cross-functional team of engineers, designers, researchers, and product managers, you'll work on platforms that serve Airbnb's entire global workforce.

Our portfolio includes One Airbnb (the company's internal cultural hub with enterprise search, people profiles, and AI-powered chat), OneChat (Airbnb's enterprise AI assistant enabling secure LLM interactions), and a suite of tools that power how employees discover information, connect with colleagues, and get work done.

You'll be joining the AI for Non-Developers workstream, focused on expanding AI productivity tools to all Airbnb employees—building OneChat Agents, deep research capabilities, artifact creation tools, and task automation that make AI accessible to everyone, regardless of technical background.

The Difference You Will Make

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Airfam Products team, you'll be instrumental in building Airbnb's next generation of AI-powered employee experience platforms. Your work will be a force multiplier for the entire company—every AI feature you ship, every system you architect, and every engineer you mentor will amplify productivity across Airbnb's global workforce.

You will:

  • Democratize AI by building tools that empower non-technical employees to leverage the power of LLMs
  • Drive innovation by taking AI prototypes from concept to production at scale
  • Shape the future of how Airbnb employees work, collaborate, and discover information

A Typical Day

  • Lead the technical design and implementation of LLM-powered features for OneChat and enterprise AI tools, including RAG pipelines, AI agents, and prompt optimization
  • Partner with product managers, designers, and cross-functional teams to translate user problems into AI-powered solutions that serve Airbnb's global workforce
  • Develop and iterate on agentic AI capabilities, including multi-step reasoning, tool use, and context-aware decision-making
  • Implement evaluation pipelines and quality systems to measure model performance, detect hallucinations, and ensure responsible AI practices
  • Own production AI systems end-to-end, including deployment strategies, monitoring, alerting, and incident response
  • Collaborate with the DevAI team on AirChat SDK integrations, MCP (Model Context Protocol) implementations, and Glean Action Packs
  • Mentor engineers (L6-L8) through design reviews, architecture discussions, and pair programming sessions
  • Stay current with the rapidly evolving GenAI landscape, evaluating new models and techniques for potential application
  • Balance hands-on technical contributions with technical leadership activities

Your Expertise

Required:

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience, with significant focus on building production AI/ML systems
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), including fine-tuning, prompt engineering, embeddings, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)
  • Strong proficiency in backend technologies (TypeScript, Go, or Java)
  • Strong backend and distributed systems expertise, including API design (REST, GraphQL) and cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
  • Track record of shipping AI-powered products from prototype to production
  • Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally and influence without authority
  • Excellent communication skills with ability to distill complex technical concepts for diverse audiences
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience

column9: We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Site Reliability Engineering team. As a Senior Software Engineer in Production SRE, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining the tools and systems that enable our engineering teams to operate our services reliably and at scale. You will work closely with our SREs and other engineering teams to ensure our services are properly instrumented and able to scale with our growing business.&lt

column3: &lt

column4: reliability and improving how the company manages incidents broadly. Your ability to identify opportunities for improvement and drive their implementation will contribute significantly to our overall operational efficiency and growth, ensuring that our services remain resilient as our business continues to expand.&lt

column3: Additionally, as an essential part of this role, you will serve as an active member of the Production SRE team, responding to and managing high severity incidents. You will guide cross-functional teams during crisis situations and ensure timely resolution, minimizing the impact on our customers and business. This aspect of your work will require not just strong technical acumen, but also excellent communication and coordination skills, resilience under pressure, and a firm commitment to our culture of blamelessness and continuous learning.&lt
&lt

column3: Viaduct is a unified data access layer connecting most of Airbnb’s online data. More than 70% of Airbnb’s API traffic flows through the Viaduct platform.&amp

column5: query system through a GraphQL interface.&amp

column3: The Viaduct team is a very tenured and experienced team, setting the best practices and next-gen architecture for Airbnb.&lt

As part of the Application Platform pillar of Infrastructure, we work closely with partner infra teams (Build Infra, Service Platform, CI/CD, Reliability, Observability, Developer Platform to name a few) as well as product engineers.&lt
We treat our platform as a product and follow the principles of good Platform Engineering&lt

Viaduct has been running in production for over six years and the team has gained a lot of experience in operating a GraphQL platform at scale. These insights informed the major rewrite - called Viaduct Modern - which we’re in the process of launching and continue to evolve. column9: as an Open Source project. Your contributions to the Viaduct platform will not only serve Airbnb-internal developers, but also any member of the Open Source community who chooses to adopt Viaduct.&lt

column3: &lt

Orchestrate and influence multiple technical tracks on the team from the core query engine and performance infrastructure to API ergonomics and reliability tooling, ensuring they interlock into a coherent, world-class developer platform.&lt

Champion the evolution of Viaduct’s global GraphQL schema: guide the multi-partner steering committee, strengthen governance processes, and drive a long-term vision that scales with Airbnb’s growing product surface and data-as-a-service strategy.&amp

Act as a multiplier for senior talent on the team: mentor teammates, cultivate technical leadership across Viaduct sub-teams, and foster an environment where every engineer can drive impactful initiatives.&lt
Serve as a key technical voice partnering with product, infrastructure, and leadership stakeholders to align Viaduct’s roadmap with Airbnb’s strategic objectives.&lt
Shape how hundreds of engineers and external open-source adopters build, ship, and operate GraphQL services by advancing Viaduct Modern and defining the next wave of capabilities.&lt
&lt
Dive deep into Viaduct’s engine, API layer, build system and performance tooling, identifying cross-cutting opportunities to raise reliability, efficiency, and developer delight.&lt
Pair with teammates to untangle complex challenges, providing architectural guidance while amplifying their ownership and growth.&lt

Embrace and be a role model for an AI-first engineering approach, using LLM-powered agents to generate and iterate on code while you focus on problem-solving, system design, and quality oversight.&lt
Partner with tenant teams to troubleshoot production issues, design self-service APIs, and evangelize GraphQL best practices through docs, talks, and office hours.&lt
Contribute to and demonstrate ownership of the open-source Viaduct project garnering feedback from the community and shaping our external roadmap.&lt

column3: Guest Experience is responsible for Search and Discovery, Merchandising, and end-to-end online software experience worldwide from top-of-funnel discovery through post-booking engagement. We are looking for a talented Data Scientist to join the Guest Data Science team. This tech lead will be at the core of using AI and casual inference to understand user behavior in our app, detect underlying intent, and to build data products needed to provide a compelling and personalized experience of our app. We build products that help guests find the inventory most relevant to them in our marketplace.&lt
&lt

As a Senior Staff Data Scientist, you will lead innovation efforts to build methodologies to identify and evaluate the preferences important to every guest, at every step of their online discovery funnel. You will be instrumental in shaping our data strategy to drive guest conversion and regular engagement with the Airbnb platform across our Homes, Experiences and Services business verticals.&amp

This role emphasizes technical excellence and driving business impact with cutting-edge science. Your role will involve close collaboration with Product to identify in-product optimizations and shape UX design architecture to path how guests navigate from surface-to-surface in our app.&lt

The ideal candidate will demonstrate to be a domain expert with granular user behavior and sequence datasets in a marketplace setting. You will hold a high bar for our customer experience and balance a passion for AI with a strong desire to accurately understand user behavior and business success. Your efforts towards personalized content discovery will help make Airbnb feel tailored for you, maintaining a dialogue with our guests to deeply understand their preferences and reflect that understanding back to them, enabling every guest to easily discover the travel they will love.&lt
&amp
&lt
Learn: Develop deep understanding of how guests navigate and re-engage with our app via analysis, research, and by leveraging granular user action and sequence datasets.&lt
Partner: With product and engineering, drive technical frameworks and science leadership to explore innovative paradigms for detecting revealed preferences and quantifying online frictions.&lt
Build: Write code for prototypes to detect and quantify taxonomy of guest preferences via iterative development of data frameworks, models and artefacts derived from AI toolkits&lt

Evaluate: Assess assumptions and efficacy of derived guest preferences via measurement and validating hypotheses linked to online guest action and engagement. Setup experiments and data feedback loops to own a high bar over continuous impact.&lt
Influence: Regularly present findings and recommendations to leadership audiences to inform strategy and cross-functional deliverables.&lt
If you’re passionate about going deep into personalized user experiences, we want to hear from you!&lt
&lt
Causal inference expertise with marketplace experience&lt
Preferred domain experience in search, UX discovery, personalized evidence systems&lt
Advanced degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Econometrics or related field.&lt
9+ years of industry experience with a PhD (or 12+ years with a Masters)&lt
Strong in communication with XFN partners in product, engineering, and design to enable data-driven product development with a focus on the user experience.&lt

Expert in at least one programming language for data analysis (Python or R) with familiarity in SQL. Comfort with developing proof-of-concept prototypes. Passionate about AI and possessing a learner’s mindset towards LLMs and dynamic systems.&lt
Proven ability to succeed in both collaborative and independent work environments&lt
Demonstrated willingness and track record of engagement with the technical community&lt
&amp

As a Senior Staff Engineer, you will serve as the connective tissue across Compliance's multi-year strategic initiatives — defining how components fit together, identifying where capabilities can be shared rather than duplicated, and ensuring we leverage platform investments from partner teams. Your decisions will directly affect how Airbnb meets obligations such as Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Know Your Customer (KYC), and sanctions screening while minimizing operational cost and customer friction.

This role extends well beyond the Compliance organization itself. You will partner directly with cross-organizational engineering teams, as well as cross-functional stakeholders across Product, Content, Legal, and Design.   • Architect systems that adapt to the evolving digital identity landscape — including new verification standards, government-issued digital credentials, and shifting privacy regulations — without requiring costly re-platforming.

  • Partner with technical leaders across multiple organizations to drive alignment on shared capabilities and cohesive system design, reducing duplication and compounding technical debt.
  • Work closely with Product, Design, Policy, Legal, Operations, and other cross-functional partners as part of a globally distributed team to define and ship impactful features.
  • Lead and mentor engineers — both inside and outside your immediate team — raising the technical bar and developing the next generation of technical leaders within Compliance.
  • Advocate for and drive systemic improvements by identifying patterns to streamline development, reduce toil, and increase technical quality and operational excellence over time.

column3: Everyone at Airbnb thinks about trust, but our team obsesses over it daily. At the core of trust is safety, and thus we spend a significant amount of our time and energy keeping the community safe. The Trust team is responsible for developing the technology that helps protect our community and platform from fraud while also ensuring our hosts, guests, homes, and experiences meet our high standards. We constantly work to fight against online fraud (such as monetary loss, compromised accounts, spam and scam in messages, fake inventory, etc.) as well as offline fraud (theft, property damage, personal safety, etc.). We also work on onboarding and screening of users, and think about complex topics like identity and reputation to ensure that every interaction with Airbnb helps build trust in us and our community. Trust Engineering is responsible for the technology vision and development of a complex stack that runs on every key interaction on the platform. Trust Engineering is at the forefront of AI and ML innovation, helping develop novel techniques and advancing the state-of-art in Machine Learning to continually build and maintain trust across our platform.&lt
&lt

Although you will be at one of our highest levels of seniority, all individual contributors at Airbnb are Software Engineers which means we expect you to be hands on and contribute code.&lt
&lt

Work with large scale structured and unstructured data, build and continuously improve cutting edge Machine Learning models for Airbnb product, business and operational use cases.&lt

Work collaboratively with cross-functional partners including software engineers, product managers, operations and data scientists, identify opportunities for business impact, understand, refine, and prioritize requirements for machine learning models, drive engineering decisions, and quantify impact.&lt
Work closely with other trust defense and platform teams to tackle the changing landscape of fraud attacks.&lt
Hands-on develop, productionize, and operate Machine Learning models and pipelines at scale, including both batch and real-time use cases.&lt
Examples include: Anomaly detection models, ML models for continuous risk evaluation, Multimodality and Agentic AI&lt

column3: BizTech fosters culture and connection at Airbnb by providing reliable corporate tools, innovative products, and technical support for all teams. We drive technical breakthroughs and strategies that redefine what it means to belong anywhere, delivering greater value for the business and our people. The Global Operations team at BizTech manages production services across Airbnb’s corporate environment, delivering reliable operations through Observability, Incident Management, Core Operations, and AI-enabled automation. We partner across BizTech to scale service quality, efficiency, and resilience.&amp
&lt

As a Senior Staff Engineer in Operations, you will lead and mentor a high-performing team to scale our AI-enabled operations model and deliver AIOps solutions that streamline operational workstreams and help BizTech teams focus on their core work with confidence. Ops owns triage and resolution, proactive monitoring across networks, systems, applications, and cloud services via a homegrown observability platform, and drives process excellence through automation and shift-left programs. You will set the technical bar, model operational excellence, and ensure high-quality, reliable service.&lt
Your scope includes leading projects across multiple products and platforms, delivering world-class outcomes that create customer and community value while balancing near- and long-term needs.&lt

You will own the AIOps vision, strategy, and roadmap, partnering with the in-house Observability platform owner to leverage infrastructure and data for accurate, correlated insights that streamline Operations. You’ll drive execution by setting priorities, building accountability, and collaborating effectively across teams. You will partner with BizTech engineering teams to improve service efficiency and security, and lead 1–3 year operations architecture planning to connect production systems and improve compatibility and stability.&lt

You will identify and eliminate recurring issues through scalable automation, improving operational performance and productivity. You’ll also lead the development and maintenance of testing and monitoring tooling to ensure automation platforms run reliably.&lt
You will be accountable for the quality and reliability of BizTech services, including validating postmortems, driving root-cause analysis, and ensuring corrective actions are implemented.&lt
&lt
You’ll lead technical strategy and discussions, partnering with Operations peers and cross-functional BizTech teams to build AIOps and automation solutions.&lt
You’ll stay on top of tasks, engagements, and team interactions—active collaboration is key to success.&lt
You’ll work in sprints, delivering project work across coding, testing, design, documentation, and operational readiness reviews.&lt
You’ll dedicate part of each day to core Operations work, triaging tickets, spotting patterns, and driving scalable fixes that improve efficiency.&lt
You’ll participate in an on-call rotation, leading high-severity incident response as both incident commander and operations engineer.&lt
&lt
15+ years of experience across AIOps, data catalog architecture, product development, and/or Technical Operations infrastructure.&lt
Strong SDLC experience, including infrastructure as code, configuration management, distributed version control, and CI/CD.&lt
Deep expertise in complex enterprise infrastructure, especially cloud (AWS and/or Google), with a focus on AI/automation, data catalog architecture, workflows, and correlation.&lt
Solid understanding of corporate infrastructure and applications to translate into AIOps requirements and integrations.&lt
Proven ability to lead cross-team, cross-org delivery of large-scale, technically complex, ambiguous initiatives that anticipate business needs.&lt
Proficient in Python or Go.&lt
Experience building API integrations and event-driven architectures (e.g., AWS Lambda/SQS).&lt

column3: Airbnb’s mission is to create a world where people can Belong Anywhere. As we grow to achieve that mission, we’re looking to add a technical, hands-on, and mission-driven Senior Technical Program Manager (TPM) to the Hosting Services team.&amp

Hosting Services focuses on building tools that make hosting on Airbnb easier. This includes building new as well as expanding existing solutions, such as co-host matching and management tools, as well as systems that enhance campaign delivery and host referrals across the platform. The team works across multiple tracks to simplify the hosting experience and unlock growth for both new and existing hosts.&lt
&lt

We are seeking a Senior TPM who is genuinely excited about leveraging AI to redefine what is possible in this role. You will be the force multiplier that can scale the team’s impact tenfold, automate repetitive workflows, and free up time for strategic thinking and complex problem-solving. The ideal candidate will proactively champion the adoption of AI tools across projects and inspire their teams to embrace these technologies, transforming how we work and ultimately delivering exponentially greater value to our hosts and the broader Airbnb community.&lt

You will play a crucial role in tackling complexity and delivering predictable, consistent, and impactful results. You will be leading complex projects/programs that touch multiple product surfaces, services, functions and teams, and hence are required to keep the big picture in focus while being able to dive into the details, working through unique challenges. Success in this role requires a strong sense of ownership, coupled with the ability to think critically and strategically while managing relationships with cross-functional stakeholders.&lt

Develop and manage comprehensive project plans to execute on initiatives, identify key milestones and ensure alignment across stakeholders&lt
Think both broadly about overall outcomes while using good judgment on where to focus in on details&amp
Influence the technical direction of projects to meet the stakeholders’ needs while upholding quality. Quickly validate project ideas through iterative development, and pivot as necessary.&lt
Define and align on success criteria for both short term and long term business goals, regularly assessing risks and opportunities and identifying mitigation strategies.&lt
Manage effective communication channels to keep a wider range of stakeholders updated on the progress&lt
Showcase the work in front of senior leaders, clearly communicate trade-offs, risks, and opportunities&lt
&lt
7+ years of experience in the software development industry, with at least 5 years as a TPM or relevant experience&amp
Experience using AI to automate manual processes to improve you and your team’s productivity&lt

Demonstrated ability to work through ambiguity to detailed solutions. You can take a vague problem, crisply frame the challenge, identify a path forward, and drive an initiative over the finish-line.&lt
Self-motivated, proactive and proven ability to adapt well and work with teams having different operating cadences.&lt
Sound business judgment, a proven ability to influence others, strong analytical skills, and a track record of taking ownership, leading data driven analyses, and influencing results&lt
Experience with ML models, LLMs, LRMs, feature development, model testing and resource management to support the development of AI-powered product experiences.&lt
Familiar with A/B testing, incremental delivery and deployment.&lt
Ability to ramp up quickly and learn new technologies with minimal lag time.&lt
Excellent written and oral business communication and people skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders.&lt

  • Démontrer une mentalité de propriétaire et un bon jugement ainsi que la capacité de remettre en question et de s'écarter du flux de travail lorsque cela est nécessaire uniquement avec l'approbation de la direction.
  • Être très réceptif aux retours de la Direction et de la Qualité, et adopter rapidement des comportements pour améliorer la qualité de votre travail.
  • Comprendre plusieurs perspectives sur un sujet ou une situation et est capable d'évaluer et de présenter plusieurs options pour résoudre un problème.
  • Peut être amené à s'engager davantage avec les parties prenantes de haut niveau et à collaborer de manière interfonctionnelle, avec l'aide de la direction.

Combiner efficacité et qualité sur mesure : Fournir un support client personnalisé et exceptionnel aux voyageurs et aux hôtes, en veillant à ce que leurs besoins et préférences uniques soient satisfaits avec le plus haut niveau de soin et d'attention.

  • Afficher une capacité à traiter un plus grand volume de cas sans impact négatif sur la qualité de l'interaction et la résolution.
  • Anticiper et identifier de manière proactive les opportunités d'améliorer l'expérience utilisateur et, avec le soutien de la direction, proposer des solutions et des recommandations sur mesure qui vont au-delà de leurs attentes, et garantir une expérience fluide et mémorable tout au long de leurs interactions avec Airbnb.
  • Résoudre les problèmes des utilisateurs rapidement et avec un niveau élevé de satisfaction mutuelle, en tenant compte du contexte et des circonstances spécifiques.
  • Personnaliser les communications avec les utilisateurs, en démontrant les normes d'hospitalité les plus élevées.

Participer à l'amélioration de votre équipe : exploitez vos connaissances opérationnelles fonctionnelles pour soutenir de manière proactive la réussite de l'équipe

  • Fournir des informations sur l'expérience de la communauté et les opportunités d'amélioration continue à votre direction.
  • Aider à documenter les méthodes de travail, les meilleures pratiques et les normes pour votre (vos) service (s), à la demande de la direction.
  • Fournir des services techniques/fonctionnels/SME aux membres les moins expérimentés de l'équipe.
  • Partager des idées pour améliorer les processus et les méthodes de travail.

Engagement des parties prenantes : Vous avez gagné la confiance des parties prenantes internes et externes grâce à une gestion efficace des relations et à l'obtention de résultats.

  • Faire preuve d’ouverture et d’accessibilité lors de la résolution des problèmes.
  • Comprendre les principaux moteurs de votre fonction et leurs relations les uns avec les autres, ainsi que l'impact commercial de ces mesures.
  • Être de garde pour gérer les situations d'urgence le soir et le week-end.

Votre parcours et votre expérience

  • Au moins 3 ans d'expérience pertinente dans des équipes de service client multiculturelles, de préférence dans le secteur hôtelier (une expérience avec une clientèle de haut niveau et influente est préférable) et dans un rôle de prise d'appels et de gestion des contacts clients/clients.
  • Une expérience en hôtellerie est un plus, notamment en travaillant pour des plateformes technologiques. Une expérience préalable de l'utilisation du téléphone, de la messagerie ou du chat en direct pour interagir avec les utilisateurs/clients est préférable.
column59:
• Expérience en collaboration avec des parties prenantes de niveau exécutif pour résoudre les conflits de manière détaillée, efficace et rapide, et capacité démontrée à expliquer des idées complexes de manière simple et claire.
  • Capacité à travailler les week-ends et les jours fériés requis, ainsi que les quarts de soir. Veuillez noter que ce rôle nécessite de travailler du dimanche au jeudi OU du mardi au samedi pendant 9 heures par jour (y compris une pause d'une heure) entre 6 h et 21 h (dans votre fuseau horaire local à travers le Canada). Votre horaire peut changer pour répondre aux besoins de l'entreprise et, dans la mesure du possible, nous prendrons en considération vos disponibilités.
column60:
Vos compétences et expertises

  • Très bonnes compétences en communication verbale et écrite pour fournir un service client exceptionnel aux voyageurs/hôtes et interagir avec les parties prenantes
  • Compétences d'écoute active pour comprendre les besoins des clients et fournir des recommandations et une assistance personnalisées
  • Empathie et patience dans les relations avec les clients, en particulier dans les situations de haute pression
  • Capacité à organiser un volume de travail élevé, à effectuer plusieurs tâches et à établir des priorités, et à travailler selon des horaires prescrits, y compris les pauses, les déjeuners et le temps de formation.
  • Passion pour offrir un service client exceptionnel et placer la barre haute
  • Capacité à prospérer dans un environnement ambigu, rapide et complexe, en agissant de manière proactive pour réagir rapidement et de manière décisive.
  • Bonnes compétences informatiques, notamment Apple/Mac OS, Google Suite, connaissance des systèmes CRM et capacité d'apprendre rapidement de nouveaux outils.
  • Maîtrise de l'anglais et francais obligatoire.

Votre emplacement :

En raison de la nature de ce poste, le candidat retenu devra être basé au Canada pour pouvoir effectuer son travail. Actuellement, les employés peuvent être situés dans : la Colombie-Britannique, l'Ontario, le Québec, l'Alberta ou le Saskatchewan. Cette liste est continuellement mise à jour, veuillez vérifier avec nous si les provinces dans lesquelles vous vivez figurent sur la liste. Si votre poste est employé par une autre entité Airbnb, votre recruteur vous informera des provinces dans lesquelles vous êtes éligible pour travailler.

Airbnb s'engage à travailler avec le vivier de talents le plus large possible. Nous pensons que la diversité des idées favorise l’innovation et l’engagement, et nous permet d’attirer des personnes créatives et de développer les meilleurs produits, services et solutions. Toutes les personnes qualifiées sont encouragées à postuler.

>La différence que vous apporterez :

Le/la Spécialiste, Soutien Premium, travaille en première ligne et interagit directement avec les clients et les parties prenantes internes. À ce poste, vous serez principalement responsable de fournir un soutien complet aux membres clés de notre communauté confrontés à un problème relatif à leur réservation, notamment, mais sans s’y limiter, au segment Luxe. Vous prendrez en charge des dossiers, en assurant la résolution complète tout en favorisant des relations solides avec nos utilisateurs.

Un(e) Spécialiste, Soutien Premium doit avoir de solides compétences en communication, en résolution de problèmes et en service à la clientèle. Vous devrez faire preuve d’une grande autonomie, être capable d’évaluer une situation et de toujours rechercher la solution la plus appropriée tant pour les hôtes, les utilisateurs que pour les parties prenantes internes. Dans le cadre de ce rôle, vous devez faire preuve de flexibilité et il se peut que vous soyez amené(e) à changer d’équipe au sein du Soutien à la communauté et/ou à occuper des responsabilités différentes de celles décrites ci-dessous. Le/la candidat(e) idéal(e) sera ouvert(e) à un rôle évolutif en fonction des besoins de l’entreprise et fera preuve de flexibilité pour répondre à ces besoins.

column9: The Quality Engineering team helps Airbnb build high-quality software efficiently. We enable Airbnb engineers to build highly testable systems by building and using tools leveraging AI. column3: &lt
Be a leader in Airbnb leveraging AI to redefine and accelerate Quality Engineering.&lt

As a Staff Automation Engineer, you will help us meet this challenge by driving the strategy towards comprehensive automation coverage for features and releases. You will work directly with the product engineering team to develop and maintain our test tools, write and test product code, participate in design reviews to architect testable systems, and guide designs and code to enhance modularity and testability.&lt

You are eager to understand complex systems top to bottom and thrive working across technologies and codebases. In addition, you excel at working through ambiguity, concept validation, and implementing best-in-class solutions.&lt

As a global company, our mission is to develop and maintain the necessary quality engineering processes that scale to meet the needs of both our external customers and internal teams. We strive to ensure that our product and support workflows deliver a seamless experience for guests, hosts, and support agents.&lt
&lt

Leverage AI and tooling to lead the implementation of a test automation strategy, covering the entire testing pyramid (unit, service, integration, and end-to-end testing) to verify feature functionality for customer use cases.&lt

Lead building, maintaining, and effective utilization of automated tests, collaborating closely with engineering teams to ensure robust test coverage for features and releases, and actively participating in the continuous improvement of testing processes.&lt
Contribute to improving existing automation frameworks to support new functionalities and optimize quality and efficiency.&lt
Collaborate with CI/CD team to integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines, ensuring thorough test coverage at every stage of development.&lt
Demonstrate excellent troubleshooting abilities, isolate issues, and verify bug fixes. Debug issues found during testing and after release.&lt
Be a player of our high-performance team to ensure code quality, commitment to craft and operational excellence&lt
Drive collaboration with cross-functional teams, including product management, development, and other QE teams, in a fast-paced environment with short release cycles.&lt
&lt
9+ years of industry experience in software testing and automation&amp
Demonstrable knowledge in at least one programming language (e.g., Kotlin, Java) and strong scripting skills&lt
Strong knowledge of test automation methodologies, tools, and frameworks&lt
Strong hands-on experience with automation frameworks (e.g., Espresso)&lt
Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Buildkite, Spinnaker, Jenkins) and version control systems (Git)&lt
Excellent communication skills towards facilitating interactions with cross-functional teams&lt
Expertise developing solutions to ambiguous problems, and integrations across multiple teams with significant impact&lt
Bachelor’s degree in computer science/engineering or equivalent&lt
Fluency in English (reading, writing, and speaking) is essential.&lt

We are seeking a Staff Data Scientist to join our forecasting team, operating at the intersection of statistical forecasting and financial strategy. The role focuses on owning forecasting within the revenue pipeline and hierarchy, including model selection, system design, automation, and ongoing performance management. We are looking for a self-directed practitioner who can reason about evolving business dynamics, make principled tradeoffs, and ensure forecasts remain reliable and decision relevant as the business changes.&lt
&lt

Own the design, operation, and evolution of end to end forecasting systems for revenue drivers, including data pipelines, model components, validation logic, and automated delivery into planning and financial workflows.&lt

Engage in stakeholder management, effectively communicating with various teams and levels within the organization to gather input and share insights.&lt

Continuously improve forecasting infrastructure and processes to reduce manual intervention, shorten cycle time, and increase trust in outputs.&lt

Expertise in SQL and relational databases, along with strong fluency in programming languages such as R, Python, and Stan.&lt
