column3: Listings and Host Tools Data and AI (DnA) team: This team supports host personalization products and provides data driven solutions to achieve superior host experience on Airbnb. These products include but are not limited to managing your space (MYS), host tools etc. We own data pipelines and ML models and will build services for serving that are used in the above areas.&lt
&lt

There is a huge opportunity to improve the Host and Guest experience by leveraging open source, third party, and home grown ML models. As an ML engineer, you will partner closely with our data science, product partners, and other ML + data engineers on the team to execute on these opportunities in order to improve the Host and Guest product experience on Airbnb.&lt
&lt
Work with large scale structured and unstructured data, build and continuously improve cutting edge Machine Learning models for Airbnb product, business and operational use cases.&lt

Work collaboratively with cross-functional partners including software engineers, product managers, operations and data scientists, identify opportunities for business impact, understand, refine, and prioritize requirements for machine learning models, drive engineering decisions, and quantify impact.&lt
Prototype machine learning use cases for use in the product, and work with stakeholders to iterate on requirements.&lt
Develop, productionize, and operate Machine Learning models and pipelines at scale, including both batch and real-time use cases.&lt
Design and build services, API to enable serving ML model driven data to product use cases.&lt
&lt
8+ years of industry experience in applied Machine Learning, inclusive MS or PhD in relevant fields.&lt
Must have experience in both Natural Language Processing and Computer Vision.&lt
Strong programming (Scala / Python / Java/ C++ or equivalent) and data engineering skills&lt

Deep understanding of Machine Learning best practices (eg. training/serving skew minimization, A/B test, feature engineering, feature/model selection), algorithms (eg. gradient boosted trees, neural networks/deep learning, optimization, state-of-art NLP and CV algorithms) and domains (eg. natural language processing, computer vision, personalization and recommendation, anomaly detection)&lt
Experience with 3 or more of these technologies: Tensorflow, PyTorch, Kubernetes, Spark, Airflow (or equivalent), data warehouse (eg. Hive)&lt
Industry experience building end-to-end Machine Learning infrastructure and/or building and productionizing Machine Learning models, as well as integrating to product use cases.&lt
Exposure to architectural patterns of a large, high-scale software applications (e.g., well-designed APIs, high volume data pipelines, efficient algorithms, models)&lt
Experience with test driven development, familiar with A/B testing, incremental delivery and deployment.&lt

column3: At Airbnb, if there’s anything related to money, it comes to the Payments team. We are building a world-class payments and commerce organization - one that currently supports 191+ countries, 70 currencies, connects dozens of payment providers and banks, processes multiple billions of dollars, and empowers more people to participate in our global marketplace.&lt

We’re looking for people who know and use Airbnb and believe in what we’re trying to accomplish. Airbnb is a marketplace that connects guests and hosts, and Payments is central to creating the trust that makes every transaction possible.&lt

The Platform team plays the role of conductor, bringing together engineers, designers, and data scientists to build great product experiences. Our Payments Platform Managers own outcomes across foundation, growth, and empowerment, setting the vision and strategy, defining the roadmap, and driving execution.&lt
&lt

This is a highly strategic, senior role with a mandate to define and build a new product area from the ground up. You will own the full stack of the business host payout experience -- both in-product (app and web) and through our API and developer platform -- and will be responsible for developing net-new financial management products. You will partner with a cross-functional team of engineers, designers, data scientists, and field operations to build and scale these capabilities. You will also work closely with external enterprise partners and business host stakeholders to deeply understand their needs and ensure the products we build drive real business impact.&lt
&lt
Payout instrument management flows: enabling business hosts to set up, manage, and optimize payout methods across multiple accounts and currencies&lt
Host team management flows: tools and permissions that allow business hosts to delegate access and manage large internal teams operating across their Airbnb accounts&lt
Earnings reconciliation flows: comprehensive reporting and reconciliation capabilities designed to meet the accounting and financial operations needs of large-scale hosts&lt
New financial services offerings: identifying and building value-added financial products and services tailored to the unique needs of business hosts&lt
&lt
8+ years of experience building payments or financial products in a product management role, with a track record of owning strategy, roadmap, and execution&lt
Demonstrated experience building enterprise or B2B products for large business customers, including deep understanding of enterprise needs and workflows&lt
Experience building or managing API-based products and developer-facing platforms, with the ability to engage credibly with engineering teams and external developer partners&lt
Global and multi-market experience: track record of building products that serve customers across multiple geographies, currencies, and regulatory environments&lt
Ability to articulate a clear, compelling vision and strategy for a product area and rally cross-functional teams around it&lt
Exceptional prioritization and decision-making skills: given competing needs and limited resources, able to make clear tradeoffs and communicate rationale to stakeholders at all levels&lt
Ability to build strong partnerships inside and outside the Product organization, including with operations, compliance, finance, legal, and external enterprise&lt
Preferred Qualifications:&lt
Technical background: prior experience as an engineer, data scientist, or in payment operations is a strong plus&lt
Experience with global payout methods, disbursement networks, or treasury management products&amp
Experience with financial services product development, including financial reporting, reconciliation, or accounting workflow tooling for business customers&lt
Experience at a consumer marketplace or two-sided platform with both B2B and B2C product surface areas&lt
Demonstrated ability to successfully scale products from 0&amp

column3: Airbnb’s mission is to create a world where people can Belong Anywhere. As we grow to achieve that mission, we’re looking to add a technical, hands-on, and mission-driven Technical Program Manager (TPM) for the Community Support Engineering (CSE) team.&lt

This person will partner with our CS engineering, ops and product teams to build/enhance decision making across multiple areas in Airbnb. They will partner closely with the engineering leaders in CSE on processes, strategy and execution.&lt

The team is looking for a person with the technical background, who understands the problem space, will drive requirements, leverage and apply their expertise to solve strategic problems at Airbnb.&lt
&lt
If you strive to improve productivity, have a strong analytical approach to problems, and love the challenge of building new organizational capabilities, this is the role for you.&lt

TPMs at Airbnb work on a variety of complex projects/ programs that touch multiple product surfaces, services, functions and teams, and hence are required to keep the big picture in focus while being able to dive into the details, working through unique challenges. It is a highly leveraged role that aims to improve the quality and velocity of work across cross-functional teams by acting as a “force multiplier.” This includes managing project schedules, identifying risks, discussing the technical trade-offs with engineers, and maintaining clear communications across multiple stakeholder groups across the organization. They make work repeatable by creating and improving processes where applicable. In short, they get things done by bringing clarity out of chaos, diving into the details, and communicating clearly and in a timely manner. They&#39

column3: The Strategic Sourcing team is part of Airbnb’s Global Procurement organization and plays a key role in enabling Airbnb to operate efficiently and scale sustainably. We partner closely with internal stakeholders to design and deliver sourcing strategies that align with Airbnb’s business priorities while driving innovation, value, and stakeholder success.&lt

We are a collaborative, forward-thinking team that embraces an AI-first mindset — leveraging technology, automation, and data to simplify processes and unlock new efficiencies. Guided by Airbnb’s mission to create a world where anyone can belong, we focus on delivering value through curiosity, creativity, and integrity.&lt
Key cross-functional partners: Finance, Legal, Business Operations.&lt
&lt

As the Strategic Sourcing Manager at Airbnb, you will play a high-visibility role impacting Airbnb’s operational efficiency, stakeholder success, and bottom line. You’ll lead end-to-end sourcing and supplier relationship management across key spend areas such as Community Support (Contact Center) services - including global outsourced support operations, vendor strategy, and performance governance - as well as other business operations partners. Acting as a trusted advisor, you’ll bring deep operations, procurement expertise, strategic thinking, and clear communication to influence decisions, mitigate risks, and drive supplier performance.&lt

You will develop and execute category plans that align with business priorities, identifying opportunities for cost optimization, supplier innovation, and risk mitigation across the BPO category. Success in this role means delivering measurable cost and value improvements, advancing supplier diversity and innovation, and shaping Airbnb’s sourcing strategy to support company growth and operational excellence.&lt
Identifying and leading initiatives to simplify sourcing and procurement processes.&lt
Developing new processes or frameworks that enhance effectiveness and business impact.&lt
Contributing to a culture of operational excellence by sharing best practices and driving measurable improvements.&lt
&lt
Partner with business leaders across the organization to understand needs and translate them into sourcing strategies and negotiation plans.&lt
Conduct and lead end-to-end sourcing activities, including opportunity assessments, RFPs, supplier selection, and complex contract negotiations.&lt
Analyze spend data and market trends to identify savings, innovation, and risk mitigation opportunities across BPO services and related categories.&lt
Apply AI tools and automation to streamline data analysis, supplier management, and contract workflows.&lt
Identify and implement continuous improvement initiatives, simplifying sourcing processes and driving measurable efficiency gains.&lt
Build and manage supplier relationships to ensure ongoing value delivery, service quality, and alignment with Airbnb’s diversity and sustainability objectives.&lt
Collaborate cross-functionally with Legal, Finance, and Vendor Management to develop clear commercial terms, ensure compliance, and support sound financial outcomes.&lt
Serve as a thought partner to stakeholders, offering insights on supplier capabilities, market dynamics, and cost optimization strategies.&lt

Influence vendors and internal partners to drive innovation, continuous improvement, and long-term value creation, while leading complex negotiations and contracts that mitigate risk, enhance accountability, and maximize total cost of ownership.&lt
&lt
10+ years of procurement or industry experience, ideally managing indirect spend across BPO (Contact Center) services.&lt
Bachelor’s or advanced degree in Finance, Supply Chain, Business, or a related field.&lt
Proven ability to lead complex sourcing and negotiation efforts delivering measurable savings and value.&lt
Experience applying AI or data-driven solutions to simplify procurement processes or optimize workflows.&lt
Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence senior leaders.&lt
Deep understanding of supplier management, risk mitigation, and contract governance.&lt

column3: The Strategic Sourcing team is part of Airbnb’s Global Procurement organization and plays a key role in enabling Airbnb to operate efficiently and scale sustainably. We partner closely with internal stakeholders to design and deliver sourcing strategies that align with Airbnb’s business priorities while driving innovation, value, and stakeholder success.&lt

We are a collaborative, forward-thinking team that embraces an AI-first mindset — leveraging technology, automation, and data to simplify processes and unlock new efficiencies. Guided by Airbnb’s mission to create a world where anyone can belong, we focus on delivering value through curiosity, creativity, and integrity.&lt
Key cross-functional partners: Finance, Legal, Business Operations.&lt
&lt
As the Sourcing Manager supporting Engineering and Infrastructure, you will partner directly with engineering leaders to shape how Airbnb sources and manages critical technology capabilities.&lt

This role sits at the center of major technical investments, from infrastructure platforms to emerging AI technologies. You will design sourcing strategies that balance cost efficiency, engineering velocity, and long-term scalability.&lt

You will also play a key role in advancing how sourcing integrates AI and automation into its workflows. Rather than simply executing procurement processes, you will help modernize them by improving how market intelligence, supplier comparisons, and negotiation insights are generated and used in decision-making.&lt
Success in this role means helping engineering teams make faster, better technology decisions while ensuring commercial discipline, supplier performance, and long-term value creation.&lt
&lt
Partner with CIO leadership and technology teams to understand platform needs, business requirements, and technology roadmaps.&lt
Develop sourcing strategies across enterprise SaaS platforms, enterprise applications, data platforms, security technologies, and workplace systems.&lt
Lead complex sourcing events including supplier discovery, RFPs, negotiations, and contract execution.&lt
Evaluate supplier proposals, pricing models, and long-term cost structures.&lt
Partner with Legal and Finance to structure scalable commercial terms and risk protections.&lt
Use AI-enabled tools and structured analysis to compare supplier proposals and generate negotiation insights.&lt
Develop category strategies that improve cost efficiency, supplier innovation, and long-term platform scalability.&lt
Simplify sourcing processes and improve decision frameworks used by technology stakeholders.&lt
Build strong partnerships with technology leaders to ensure sourcing is embedded early in platform investment decisions.&lt
Contribute to building repeatable sourcing knowledge frameworks that improve how decisions are made across the organization.&lt
&lt
8+ years of experience in procurement, sourcing, consulting, vendor management, or technology strategy roles.&lt
Experience sourcing enterprise software, SaaS platforms, IT services, or technology vendors.&lt
Strong commercial negotiation experience with enterprise technology suppliers.&lt
Ability to translate business requirements into structured sourcing strategies.&lt
Strong analytical skills and experience working with financial models, supplier comparisons, and contract structures.&lt
Experience using data, automation, or AI tools to support decision-making.&lt
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.&lt

Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders and external partners to drive successful negotiations and supplier outcomes.&lt
&lt
8+ years of experience in procurement, sourcing, consulting, or technology vendor management.&lt
Experience sourcing technology categories such as cloud infrastructure, developer platforms, AI technologies, or engineering services.&lt
Strong negotiation and commercial strategy experience in complex technology environments.&lt
Ability to translate technical requirements into commercial strategies and supplier decisions.&lt
Experience working with engineering or product organizations.&lt

column3: &lt

Airbnb is a mission-driven company dedicated to helping create a world where anyone can belong anywhere. The AirCover team supports this mission by standing up for Hosts and guests when things go wrong — often under intense scrutiny and at moments that materially impact trust in our platform. We operate in a fast-moving, high-stakes environment where decisions must be accurate, timely, and defensible.&lt

We are looking for a resilient, highly skilled leader who thrives under pressure and excels at steering teams through urgent, sensitive, and complex escalations. This leader is capable of juggling multiple high-impact cases concurrently, providing sound judgement even when facts are incomplete, and maintaining steady direction for both the team and senior stakeholders. They will act as the operational leader for Service Recovery in moments where the Operations Manager is not present.&lt

This role requires a strategic mindset, exceptional stakeholder management capability, and the ability to build and develop a high-performing team of escalation specialists who can operate at an executive-facing level.&lt
&lt
In this role, you will guide the Service Recovery team in delivering best-in-class support during our most sensitive, time-critical escalations.&amp
column5: You will manage competing priorities, navigate ambiguity, and ensure we maintain rigor, consistency, and empathy even under pressure.&amp
column7: You will help shape the broader AirCover escalation strategy while coaching the team to grow into trusted, high-judgement escalation handlers.&lt

column3: &lt
Team Leadership &amp
Own and manage end-to-end people strategy for the team: onboarding, capability building, continuous feedback, and performance management.&lt
Serve as the primary leader during high-pressure moments or when the Operations Manager is not available, ensuring continuity of service, judgement, and decision-making.&lt
Build a culture of accountability, clarity of expectations, and operational discipline across the team.&lt
Drive high-velocity prioritization, helping the team manage multiple urgent escalations while maintaining quality and adherence to protocols.&lt
Create and own monitoring metrics to ensure best-in-class community service.&lt
Escalation &amp
Oversee the handling of complex, sensitive, and time-critical escalations that carry brand, legal, financial, or trust risk.&lt
Serve on call as needed for incident response.&lt
Act as escalation point for point specialists and analysts for executive-level escalations, major incidents, and cross-functional escalations requiring fast, senior-level decision-making.&lt
Provide hands-on support for the most challenging cases, ensuring direction, narrative consistency, and airtight risk mitigation.&lt
Strengthen the team’s ability to independently handle high-judgement work by creating frameworks, playbooks, and escalation routing clarity.&lt
Stakeholder Management &amp
Build strong relationships with senior stakeholders across Legal, Fraud and Safety Ops, Community Policy, Product, and Market Operations.&lt
Communicate effectively with executive audiences, synthesizing complex information and recommending a clear path forward under tight timelines.&lt
Influence cross-functional partners to drive resolution, unblock key decisions, and improve operational readiness for emerging risks.&lt
Continuous Improvement &amp
Identify systemic weaknesses across processes, policies, and tools — and drive measurable improvements.&lt
Partner with the wider AirCover and Scaled Ops teams to shape roadmaps, strengthen safeguards, and refine how we manage high-stakes escalations globally.&lt
Lead or contribute to cross-functional projects that enhance the escalation ecosystem from end to end.&lt
&lt
4–6+ years of experience leading teams in high-pressure escalation, crisis management, or risk-related environments.&lt
Proven experience of incident management in a fast-paced environment.&lt
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple urgent, complex cases simultaneously without sacrificing quality or judgement.&lt
Strong performance management skills and experience developing individuals into senior-calibre escalation or risk specialists.&lt
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to craft executive-ready narratives under time pressure.&lt
Proven ability to influence and align senior stakeholders, even when priorities or perspectives differ.&lt
High analytical capability and comfort making decisions in ambiguous, evolving contexts.&lt
Strong operational judgement and the ability to balance risk mitigation with customer experience.&lt
A calm, grounded leadership style that brings steadiness to the team in fast-moving and high-stakes moments.&lt
Experience hiring and managing globally dispersed employees is a plus.&lt
&lt

This position is Canada - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. While the position is Remote Eligible, you must live in a province where Airbnb Canada, Inc. has a registered entity. Currently we can hire in the following provinces: Alberta, Ontario, British Columbia, Quebec, and Saskatchewan. This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with your recruiter on what provinces you are eligible to work from.&lt
&lt

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.&lt

If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com. Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process.&lt
We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application.&lt

column3: The BizTech Products organization is responsible for delivering innovative technology solutions that empower Airbnb&#39

column7: , you will serve as a technical leader and subject matter expert, partnering with senior leadership, cross-functional teams, and external stakeholders to drive strategic initiatives. column5: You will be held accountable to deliver on your own Cultural &amp
column7: Functional Excellence (CAFE) contributions and help promote for indirect reports to uphold their CAFE contributions, as these contributions are important for career advancement within Tech.&amp
column9: As BizTech’s footprint of regional expertise grows in India, a primary, senior resource to support multiple experts and be accountable for delivering on complex business problems is key.&amp

column3: You will serve as a bridge between our current US-based leadership, Airbnb’s global stakeholder community, while utilizing your deep technical skills and enterprise SaaS expertise to architect, optimize, and scale our technology platforms. column5: Your forward-thinking approach and ability to anticipate future needs will significantly accelerate our journey toward becoming an efficient organization centered around self-service, and early adopters of AI.&lt

column3: You will act as a leader and innovator in your area of expertise, advising and mentoring others on the team while serving as a liaison between your team and business stakeholders.&lt
